shortDescription: Poland's Orlen GPW:PKN purchased 16 additional crude oil cargoes to cover its refineries' demand, the company told Reuters on Wednesday."In connection with the situation on the raw materials market, the ORLEN Group has contracted 16 additional deliveries to Poland, the Czech Republic and Lithuania…

children: purchased 16 additional crude oil cargoes to cover its refineries' demand, the company told Reuters on Wednesday.

"In connection with the situation on the raw materials market, the ORLEN Group has contracted 16 additional deliveries to Poland, the Czech Republic and Lithuania, including from Norway, Great Britain, Algeria, Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan and the Americas," the company said.
